result.topic_en: The page gives identities for alternating infinite products and series involving log(1+64x^4/k^4) and arctan(8x^2/k^2) over odd k with weights ±k. These are expressed through Φ(1), hyperbolic and trigonometric functions, and exponential series, then specialised to odd and even integers n.
result.transcription:
$(1-\frac{1}{3^2})^{-3}(1-\frac{1}{5^2})^{5}(1-\frac{1}{7^2}[?])^{-7}(1-\frac{1}{9^2}[?])^{9}\cdots = \frac{\pi}{8}e^{\frac{4}{\pi}\Phi(1)}$
$\log(1+\frac{64x^4}{1^4}) - 3\log(1+\frac{64x^4}{3^4}) + 5\log(1+\frac{64x^4}{5^4}) - \cdots$
$= \frac{8}{\pi}\Phi(1) - 2x\log\left(\frac{\cosh\pi x+\sin\pi x}{\cosh\pi x-\sin\pi x}\right) - 4x\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{\cos\pi x}{\sinh\pi x}\right)$
$-\frac{8}{\pi}\left\{\frac{\cos\pi x}{1^2}e^{-\pi x} - \frac{\cos 3\pi x}{3^2}e^{-3\pi x} + \cdots\right\}$
$\tan^{-1}\frac{8x^2}{1^2} - 3\tan^{-1}\frac{8x^2}{3^2} + 5\tan^{-1}\frac{8x^2}{5^2} - \cdots$
$= x\log\left(\frac{\cosh\pi x+\sin\pi x}{\cosh\pi x-\sin\pi x}\right) - 2x\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{\cos\pi x}{\sinh\pi x}\right)$
$+\frac{4}{\pi}\left\{\frac{\sin\pi x}{1^2}e^{-\pi x} - \frac{\sin 3\pi x}{3^2}e^{-3\pi x} + \frac{\sin 5\pi x}{5^2}e^{-5\pi x} - \cdots\right\}$
n positive odd integer $(1+\frac{4n^4}{1^4})(1+\frac{4n^4}{3^4})^{-3}(1+\frac{4n^4}{5^4})^{5}\cdots$
$= \left(\frac{1-e^{-\frac12\pi n}}{1+e^{-\frac12\pi n}}\right)^{2n(-1)^{\frac12(n-1)}} e^{\frac{8}{\pi}\Phi(1)}$.
n any even integer $(1+\frac{4n^4}{1^4})(1+\frac{4n^4}{3^4})^{-3}(1+\frac{4n^4}{5^4})^{5}\cdots$
$= \exp\left\{\frac{8}{\pi}\Phi(1) - \frac{8}{\pi}(-1)^{\frac12 n}\left(\Phi(e^{-\frac12\pi n}) + \frac12\pi n\tan^{-1}e^{-\frac12\pi n}\right)\right\}$
n positive odd integer $\tan^{-1}\frac{2n^2}{1^2} - 3\tan^{-1}\frac{2n^2}{3^2} + \cdots$
$= \frac{4}{\pi}(-1)^{\frac12(n-1)}\left\{\frac{\pi n}{4}\log\left(\frac{1+e^{-\frac12\pi n}}{1-e^{-\frac12\pi n}}\right) + \frac{e^{-\frac12\pi n}}{1^2} + \frac{e^{-\frac32[?]\pi n}}{3^2} - \cdots\right\}$
n positive even integer: $\tan^{-1}\frac{2n^2}{1^2} - 3\tan^{-1}\frac{2n^2}{3^2} + \cdots$
$= n(-1)^{\frac12 n-1}\tan^{-1}e^{-\frac12\pi n}$.
